Experience

An evening at NASHA.

This is what the evening is designed to feel like, from the walk up to the last pour. It is a design, written in the conditional, because NASHA does not exist yet.

NASHA is in development. There is no brewery, no restaurant, no truck and no menu for sale yet. Images are concept visualizations and illustrations, not photographs of NASHA. Nobody has tested this evening.

01 Curiosity

Arrival

You would see the sign first, then warm light through glass, then the tanks.

02 Refreshment

The bar

A long bar, a wall of taps and a shelf of glasses, with the brewery in sight behind it.

03 Belonging

The table

Long tables for sharing. Plates go in the middle and glasses go round.

04 Hunger

The food

Fusion dishes and our own: Chicken 65 on masa chips, tacos, a braise, charred corn. All still being designed.

05 Refreshment

The beer

Light and crisp, wheat, toasty. Each beer is a brief with named dishes it is meant to meet.

06 Warmth

The fire

A tandoor and a comal in an open kitchen, so you can watch food meet fire.

07 Wonder

The brewery

Tanks behind glass: the slow work of fermentation, in view. Size and count are not decided.

08 Staying

The patio

A covered court under an oak, shade and fans for the heat, lights for the evening.

09 Wanting to come back

Night

By dusk the hall glows, the court fills, and nobody is in a hurry.

Before the hall, the test.

The path to this evening starts smaller: tastings, pop-ups, perhaps a brewery residency. Each step has to earn the next.

See the path

NASHA is a future Indo-Mex brewery and kitchen in Austin, Texas, in development.

The name was chosen by the founder. Legal clearance of the name is pending. Nothing here claims trademark ownership. There is no brewery, restaurant or truck open, and nothing is for sale. No site has been chosen.

In Hindi and Urdu, nasha means intoxication or addiction. We chose it for the feeling of being captivated by food and beer. We take that meaning seriously and will never present excess or addiction as something to admire. Cultural advisors will review the name and our language before launch.

Images show a possible future. The photographic-style pictures are concept visualizations made with AI tools and edited, and the drawings are illustrations. They are not photographs of NASHA, of its food, or of its beer. About these images.

Menu items are designs for testing, not served food. Heat and vegetarian labels describe how a dish is designed, not a certified allergen or dietary statement. Ask before you eat if you have an allergy. If you drink, drink responsibly. Alcohol is for adults of legal drinking age.

The word NASHA in the header and in some pictures is a temporary typographic placeholder, set in a standard font. It is not a logo, not an official brand mark, and no trademark is claimed. No logo has been approved or released.

Build of 2026-10-11.
